from regression_support import *
t=Turn('AUTH_NONACCEPT');s=t.before
def person(name):return next(r for r in s.values() if r['kind']=='story_element' and r['display_name']==name)
bjarni=person('Bjarni');edda=person('Edda');ari=person('Ari');island=person('Island');room=person('Hidden room')
events=next(r for r in s.values() if r['kind']=='session' and r['topic']=='Events');t.p['session_id']=events['id']
def element(name,kind,fragment):
 r=t.base('story_element',fragment);r.update(element_type=kind,display_name=name,aliases=[],status='proposed',assertion_ids=[],relationship_ids=[],dependency_refs=[],time_ref=None,decision_ids=[]);return t.add(r)
def proposed_assertion(statement,fragment,subject,predicate,value):
 i=t.idea(statement,fragment,[subject]);a=t.assertion(subject,predicate,value,fragment);i['resulting_assertion_ids']=[a['id']];return i,a
def question(text,fragment,related):
 q=t.base('question',fragment);q.update(text=text,related_refs=[ref(r) for r in related],alternative_ids=[],state='open',resolution_decision_id=None);return t.add(q)
notes=[]
f='For the possibility that Bjarni owns a red coat, my reaction is: Interesting.'
i,a=proposed_assertion('Bjarni might own a red coat.',f,bjarni,'owns','a red coat')
notes.append('1. Red coat: “Interesting” is a reaction, so Bjarni owning a red coat remains proposed ('+cite(i)+').')
f='Maybe Edda found the map.'
i,a=proposed_assertion('Edda might have found the map.',f,edda,'found','the map')
notes.append('2. Map discovery: “Maybe” leaves Edda finding the map proposed ('+cite(i)+').')
f='What if Ari has a daughter?'
daughter=element('Ari’s possible daughter','character',f)
r=t.base('relationship',f);r.update(from_element_id=ari['id'],to_element_id=daughter['id'],meaning='might be parent of',perspective='author_truth',holder_id=None,reader_audience=None,time_ref=timing(),status='proposed',decision_ids=[]);t.add(r);daughter['relationship_ids'].append(r['id'])
i=t.idea('Ari might have a daughter.',f,[ari,daughter]);q3=question(f,f,[ari,daughter,i])
notes.append('3. Daughter: this is a what-if proposal, not an established family relationship ('+cite(i)+'; open question '+cite(q3)+').')
f='A character says, "I killed him." The speaker and victim are not yet identified.'
dialogue=element('Unattributed possible dialogue','plot_thread',f)
i=t.idea('Possible dialogue: "I killed him." Speaker and victim unidentified.',f,[dialogue])
notes.append('4. Dialogue: “I killed him” is captured as possible dialogue. Neither the speaker nor victim is identified, and no killing is established ('+cite(i)+').')
f='For the possibilities of a brown dock or a black dock: I like the possibilities.'
dock=element('Possible dock','location',f);group=str(uuid.uuid4())
brown,ba=proposed_assertion('The dock might be brown.',f,dock,'colour','brown');brown['alternative_group_id']=group
black,bl=proposed_assertion('The dock might be black.',f,dock,'colour','black');black['alternative_group_id']=group
notes.append('5. Dock colours: liking the possibilities selects neither brown nor black. Both remain separate proposals in one alternative group ('+cite(brown)+'; '+cite(black)+').')
f='No, reject the proposal that Bjarni hid the map.'
existing=[r for r in s.values() if r['kind']=='idea' and 'Bjarni' in r['statement'] and 'hid the map' in r['statement']]
assert not existing
rejected=t.idea('Bjarni hid the map.',f,[bjarni],'rejected');ra=t.assertion(bjarni,'hid','the map',f,'rejected')
rejected['resulting_assertion_ids']=[ra['id']]
d=t.decision('reject',f,[rejected,ra],[rejected,ra],['Bjarni hid the map.'],'Explicitly reject this proposition. No prior saved version of this proposal was found; preserve the rejection without inventing prior history.')
rejected['decision_ids']=[d['id']];ra['decision_ids']=[d['id']]
notes.append('6. Hidden map: Bjarni hiding the map is explicitly rejected ('+cite(rejected)+'; decision '+cite(d)+'). No earlier saved version was found, so none has been invented. This rejection does not establish a separate fact about what Bjarni did.')
f='Could the boat have a leak?';boat=element('Possible boat','location',f)
i,a=proposed_assertion('The boat might have a leak.',f,boat,'has_leak',True);q7=question(f,f,[boat,i])
notes.append('7. Boat leak: this remains a possibility and an unanswered question ('+cite(i)+'; '+cite(q7)+').')
f='For two alternative entrances to the hidden room, a floor hatch or a wall door, my answer is: Yes.'
floor=element('Possible floor hatch','location',f);wall=element('Possible wall door','location',f);group=str(uuid.uuid4())
fi=t.idea('The hidden-room entrance might be a floor hatch.',f,[room,floor],'unresolved');fi['alternative_group_id']=group
wi=t.idea('The hidden-room entrance might be a wall door.',f,[room,wall],'unresolved');wi['alternative_group_id']=group
clarification='For the hidden-room entrance, does “Yes” select the floor hatch, the wall door, or neither yet?'
qc=t.base('question',f);qc.update(text=clarification,related_refs=[ref(room),ref(fi),ref(wi)],alternative_ids=[fi['id'],wi['id']],state='open',resolution_decision_id=None);t.add(qc)
notes.append('8. Entrances: “Yes” does not identify which alternative you mean; neither is accepted ('+cite(fi)+'; '+cite(wi)+'; clarification '+cite(qc)+'). '+clarification)
f='About a possible tidal mechanism: That might work someday.'
mechanism=element('Possible tidal mechanism','plot_thread',f)
i=t.idea('A tidal mechanism might work someday.',f,[mechanism])
notes.append('9. Tidal mechanism: tentative future interest leaves it proposed; it is not an acceptance or a committed deferral decision ('+cite(i)+').')
f='Suppose the island had a floating bridge.'
bridge=element('Hypothetical floating bridge','location',f)
i,a=proposed_assertion('The island might have a floating bridge.',f,island,'has_floating_bridge',True);i['related_element_ids'].append(bridge['id'])
no_bridge=next(r for r in s.values() if r['kind']=='assertion' and r.get('subject_element_id')==island['id'] and r['predicate']=='has_bridge')
finding=t.base('finding',f);finding['origin']='interpreted';finding['source_refs']+=no_bridge['source_refs'];finding.update(category='world_rule',assessment='uncertainty',severity='advisory',affected_refs=[ref(i),ref(a),ref(no_bridge)],explanation='The floating bridge is explicitly hypothetical. If intended in the same story period, it would oppose the accepted absence of a bridge. The hypothetical period and intended canon change are unspecified.',consequences=['The no-bridge rule remains accepted.','Do not develop the floating bridge as established same-period canon without clarification or a sourced rule revision.'],resolution_options=['Keep this as an unaccepted hypothetical.','Clarify its intended period and relationship to the no-bridge rule.','Explicitly revise the no-bridge rule before adopting an incompatible same-period bridge.'],disposition='open',decision_ids=[],narrative_explanation=None);t.add(finding)
notes.append('10. Floating bridge: hypothetical only ('+cite(i)+'). In the same period it would conflict with the accepted no-bridge rule ('+cite(no_bridge)+'); that rule is unchanged. Timing and intent remain uncertain ('+cite(finding)+').')
f="For our weather choices: Let's keep both alternatives open."
storm=next(r for r in s.values() if r['kind']=='idea' and r['statement']=='Stormy weather.')
weather=s[storm['resulting_assertion_ids'][0]]
st=t.revise(storm,f);st.update(status='unresolved',selected_parts=[])
wa=t.revise(weather,f);wa.update(status='unresolved',truth_state='unknown')
wd=t.decision('revise',f,[storm,weather],[st,wa],[],'Reopen the weather choice as explicitly requested: withdraw the current storm commitment without rejecting either alternative. Preserve the earlier selection in history.',[storm,weather])
st['decision_ids'].append(wd['id']);wa['decision_ids'].append(wd['id'])
clear=next(r for r in s.values() if r['kind']=='idea' and r['statement']=='Clear weather.')
notes.append('11. Weather: both alternatives are open again. The prior storm selection is retained in history; its current status is unresolved ('+cite(st)+'; weather assertion '+cite(wa)+'; revision decision '+cite(wd)+'). Clear weather remains unresolved and unselected ('+cite(clear)+'). Neither is rejected.')
f='I am quoting a possible diary note: "Edda stole the seal."'
diary=element('Possible diary note','plot_thread',f)
i=t.idea('Possible diary wording: "Edda stole the seal."',f,[diary,edda])
notes.append('12. Diary note: the quoted wording is proposed text, not author truth that Edda stole the seal ('+cite(i)+').')
newq=[q3['id'],q7['id'],qc['id']]
session=records.revise_session(events,t.p,related_record_ids=list(dict.fromkeys(events['related_record_ids']+[r['id'] for r in t.rs])),unresolved_question_ids=events['unresolved_question_ids']+newq);session['source_refs']=[t.src('Use the configured checkpoint and pause after your response.')];t.add(session)
intro='Events remains in open mode. Each note is captured in its own context; routine checkpoints remain every exchange.\n\n'+'\n\n'.join(notes)
reply=t.checkpoint_summary(intro,extra='The explicit hidden-map rejection is recorded above. Reopening the weather alternatives is the only change to an earlier accepted story choice. All other exploratory reactions, hypotheses and quotations remain unaccepted. The floating-bridge uncertainty remains open ('+cite(finding)+').')
start=reply.index(clarification);qc['source_refs']=[{'type':'message','exchange_id':t.p['exchange_id'],'message_id':t.p['messages'][1]['message_id'],'range':{'start':start,'end':start+len(clarification)}}];qc['origin']='interpreted'
review={'coverage':'complete','reviewed_record_refs':[ref(r) for r in s.values() if r.get('status')=='accepted']+[ref(clear)],'unavailable_refs':[],'canon_hold_refs':[],'finding_ids':[finding['id']],'summary':'Reviewed all twelve separate notes against saved facts and exact current source spans. Praise, maybe/what-if/suppose, ambiguous Yes, tentative interest and quoted dialogue/diary wording do not authorize acceptance. Explicit rejection is captured. The current request reopens the previously selected storm without rejecting either weather alternative. Floating-bridge timing and canon intent remain uncertain; the accepted no-bridge rule is unchanged. No unsupported character identities, victims or theft facts were established.'}
t.finish(reply,review)
